a.lede: The $899 Co Print Quadro IQEX 3D printer raised over $500,000 on Kickstarter, exceeding its $50,000 goal.
a.title: 3D printer that promises simultaneous printing from all four heads gets $500,000 in crowdfunding

b.lede: The Borslon finger-worn gaming mouse is the first of its kind, reaching $43,000 in its Kickstarter campaign and shattering its $5,000 goal. However, it may have some major design flaws.
b.title: Weird finger-wearable gaming mouse raises $43,000 on Kickstarter, a staggering 8x its crowdfunding goal
